svg.title: KINETICKK Demo module map
svg.desc: Layers from top to bottom; upper rows depend on lower rows. Two platform hosts (:app:desktop on the JVM and :app:web on Wasm) depend only on :app:shared, the composition root. Below it stand three feature families, :flow:session, :ball:gameplay and :ball:profile, each split into impl, interaction, nucleus and api modules; the nucleus modules are highlighted as pure deterministic logic. Under them :ball:content and :resource:audio each have impl and api modules. At the bottom are :foundation:common and :foundation:design.
